subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], I am writing to confirm your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on June 15th. Your flight is scheduled to depart at 10:00 AM from JFK Airport. Please remember to arrive at the airport at least two hours before your flight. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Travel Agency Team
